collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A small gecko watches a villager from the roof beam during supper.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A small gecko watches (name1) from the roof beam during supper. (name1) leaves a crumb on the floor, and the gecko darts down to inspect it.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A small gecko watches (name1) from the roof beam during supper. It chirps loudly, as if commenting on the meal.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A small gecko watches (name1) from the roof beam during supper. (name1) decides the gecko is a welcome guest and names it.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A small gecko watches (name1) from the roof beam during supper. It catches a moth with remarkable speed, and the family applauds.
